summary.prose: Building s9 starts with the shared ground -- the new languages, the table and view kinds, three namespaces for external libraries with their migration step, the grammar dependencies, a record of readers that cannot load and the request that lists languages, and C/C++ matched as one family -- and then adds one reader per language (C, C++, Rust, C#), each checkable on its own, and a structured SQL reader that keeps the document. It ends with a mixed repository indexed end to end and the installed daemon listing all twelve languages.

tasks.title: Add the languages, the table/view kinds, the three namespaces and the grammar dependencies
tasks.summary: Language gains rust, csharp, c, cpp and EXT_TO_LANG maps .rs, .cs, .c, .h, .cc, .cpp, .cxx, .hpp, .hh, .hxx; ENTITY_KIND_BYTE appends table: 14, view: 15 (EntityKind too); SharedModulesNamespace appends cargo/nuget/native with ids 0xFFFFFFFA/0xFFFFFFF9/0xFFFFFFF8 and names, mapped from rust/csharp/c/cpp; a V6->V7 migration step provisions their rows (provisionSharedModulesRows) and SCHEMA_VERSION becomes 7; package.json adds tree-sitter-rust 0.24.0, tree-sitter-c-sharp 0.23.1, tree-sitter-c 0.24.1, tree-sitter-cpp 0.23.4, @derekstride/tree-sitter-sql 0.3.11.
acceptanceChecks: a store at version 6 opens, migrates to 7 and holds the three namespace rows; a fresh store holds all seven
existing entity and relation rows decode unchanged
a module stub of rust/csharp/c/cpp is stored under its namespace row
all five grammars install with the repository's .npmrc and load under Node 22
tests that pin the schema version are updated to 7 and the inventory pins are refreshed

tests.name: migration step for namespaces and kinds

tasks.title: Record readers that cannot load and answer the languages request
tasks.summary: registerUnavailableReader in src/indexer/parser/registry.ts records a language, its extensions and the load error; the existing readers' guarded loads (kotlin) call it on failure; a new 'index.languages' request, classed for the code-indexing worker, returns every code and SQL language with extensions, availability and reason.
acceptanceChecks: a reader whose grammar require throws is not registered, is listed unavailable with the error, and the others register
the request lists python, go, typescript, javascript, java, scala, kotlin with availability (the new languages appear as their readers land)
the request is answered by the worker that holds the registry

tests.name: guarded grammar load records an unavailable reader

tasks.title: Match C and C++ as one family in the cross-file pass
tasks.summary: Where the cross-file pass compares a candidate's language with the caller's (same-file and cross-file call and inheritance targets), 'c' and 'cpp' match each other; every other language still matches only itself.
acceptanceChecks: a C caller resolves to a function declared in a .h read as cpp
a Python caller still never resolves to a Go function of the same name

tests.name: C/C++ family match in the cross-file pass

tasks.title: Read C
tasks.summary: A C reader (.c) behind the guarded load: file, function (definitions), type (struct/union/enum/typedef) entities; DEFINES; IMPORTS for quoted includes (resolved to the file relative to the including file) and angle includes (module stubs under 'native'); CALLS by callee name. resolveImportPath gains the c/cpp include candidates.
acceptanceChecks: a .c fixture yields its functions and types and its include and call relationships
a quoted include of a file on disk is an IMPORTS to that file (extracted); an angle include is an IMPORTS to a native module stub
a same-file call is resolved (extracted)
a fixture with a syntax error still yields the declarations outside the broken region

tasks.title: Read C++
tasks.summary: A C++ reader (.cpp, .cc, .cxx, .hpp, .hh, .hxx and .h) behind the guarded load: file, function, method (class members and qualified definitions), class/type entities, namespaces folded into names; DEFINES/CONTAINS; IMPORTS as for C; CALLS by name; INHERITS from base_class_clause.
acceptanceChecks: a .cpp/.h fixture yields classes, methods and functions and their include, call and inheritance relationships
a C file calling a function declared in a .h resolves across files through the family rule
a fixture with a syntax error still yields the declarations outside the broken region

tests.name: C caller resolves to a C++ header declaration

tasks.title: Read Rust
tasks.summary: A Rust reader (.rs) behind the guarded load: file, function, method (impl/trait members), class (struct/enum/union), interface (trait) entities; DEFINES/CONTAINS; IMPORTS for `mod x;` (x.rs, else x/mod.rs, beside the declaring file) and crate-relative `use` paths to files, external crates to module stubs under 'cargo'; CALLS by name; IMPLEMENTS from `impl Trait for Type`.
acceptanceChecks: a .rs fixture yields its items and its mod/use, call and impl relationships
`mod util;` resolves to util.rs over util/mod.rs when both exist
a fixture with a syntax error still yields the declarations outside the broken region

tasks.title: Read C#
tasks.summary: A C# reader (.cs) behind the guarded load of tree-sitter-c-sharp 0.23.1: file, class (class/record/struct), interface, type (enum/delegate), method entities with namespaces folded into names; DEFINES/CONTAINS; IMPORTS for using directives to module stubs under 'nuget'; CALLS by name (calls through a namespace stay pending -- the stated limitation); INHERITS/IMPLEMENTS from base lists.
acceptanceChecks: a .cs fixture yields its types and members and its using, call and base-list relationships
a same-file call resolves; a call into another file through a namespace stays pending
a repository with Rust, C#, C and C++ files indexed through IndexerService stores, per language, file/function/type entities and IMPORTS and CALLS relationships (ac1)
a fixture with a syntax error still yields the declarations outside the broken region

tasks.title: Read SQL as structure
tasks.summary: A SQL reader owning '.sql' (removed from the artifact reader) behind the guarded load of @derekstride/tree-sitter-sql: the whole-file document entity with the same id as before, a table or view entity per CREATE TABLE / CREATE VIEW, DEFINES, and REFERENCES from views to relations they select from and from tables to tables their foreign keys name; same-file references resolved (extracted), others pending by name.
acceptanceChecks: a SQL fixture yields the document, table and view entities and their REFERENCES (ac2)
the document entity's id equals the artifact reader's for the same file
a CTE name is not a reference; quoted identifiers are unquoted
a reference to a table in another file stays pending
the languages request lists all twelve languages available (ac4)
a fixture with a syntax error still yields the declarations outside the broken region

tasks.title: Ship and smoke on the installed daemon
tasks.summary: Full sweep once, update the installed daemon, and index a mixed repository with Rust, C#, C, C++ and SQL files: each language's entities and relationships are stored and the languages request lists all twelve as available.
acceptanceChecks: full sweep shows no failure caused by this Story
on the installed daemon: the mixed repository's five languages are indexed and the languages request lists them available (recorded)
